questions.prompt: Which contact passes power while its tag is **FALSE**?
questions.explanation: A normally closed contact passes power until its tag becomes TRUE.

questions.prompt: A and B are in parallel before the coil. Fill in when the coil is on.
questions.explanation: Parallel contacts make OR: either branch is enough.

questions.prompt: A coil's rung stops passing power. What does the coil's tag do?
options: Stays TRUE until it is reset
Keeps the value it had at power-up
questions.explanation: A plain coil follows its rung every scan; only a set coil keeps its value.
